name: Customer Support

author: Fountain Team

I'm currently investigating this issue for you. Please bear with me for a moment while I gather more information.
I've escalated your case to our specialist team who can better assist with this matter. They will reach out to you within {input:Timeframe}. Your case reference number is #{counter:case}.
I've processed a refund of ${input:Amount} to your original payment method. Please allow 5-7 business days for the amount to appear in your account. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly.

1. Go to {input:URL}
2. Click "Forgot Password"
3. Enter your email address
4. Check your inbox for the reset link
5. Create a new password

If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, please check your spam folder.

For security purposes, I'll need to verify your account. Could you please provide:
- The email address associated with your account
